summary_en: PIXTA increased its FY2026 year-end dividend forecast from 45.00 yen to 60.00 yen per share, adding a 15.00 yen commemorative dividend to the ordinary 45.00 yen dividend to mark the 20th anniversary of its PIXTA digital content marketplace.
title_en: Notice of Revision to Dividend Forecast (Commemorative Dividend)
translation_en_brief:
PIXTA Inc. announced a revision to its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending December 2026. The company increased the year-end dividend from 45.00 yen per share to 60.00 yen per share, comprising an ordinary dividend of 45.00 yen and a commemorative dividend of 15.00 yen. The revision was approved by the board of directors on November 13, 2026.

The additional 15.00 yen commemorative dividend was authorized to commemorate the 20th anniversary of PIXTA, the company's digital content marketplace, and to express gratitude to shareholders for their continued support. The proposed dividend is subject to approval at the company's 22nd annual general meeting of shareholders scheduled for March 2027.
